Geometric31Obstruction.cite: No rational 31-torsion on a geometrically split abelian surface, census proof of 20 October 2026. Elliptic torsion bounds and a Galois-stable split quadratic order in the geometric endomorphism algebra.
Geometric31Obstruction.used_for: impossibility of [31] for every geometrically split abelian surface over ℚ, independently of the geometric splitting degree

Geometric3334Obstruction.cite: No rational points of order 33 or 34 on geometrically split abelian surfaces, census proof of 20 October 2026. Combining coprime torsion within an elliptic isogeny class, quartic elliptic torsion, and the Galois action on geometric endomorphisms.
Geometric3334Obstruction.used_for: impossibility of [33] and [34] for every geometrically split abelian surface over ℚ, independently of the geometric splitting degree

QSimple35Obstruction.cite: No rational 35-torsion on a geometrically split abelian surface simple over Q, census proof of 20 October 2026. Coprime torsion in elliptic isogeny classes and a cyclotomic obstruction from the polarization.

Geometric22Obstruction.cite: No rational points of order 22 on geometrically split abelian surfaces, census proof of 21 October 2026. A residual tensor argument at 11 for non-CM geometric squares, torsion of quadratic Q-curves and of CM elliptic curves, and coprime torsion in an elliptic isogeny class over a quadratic field.
Geometric22Obstruction.used_for: impossibility of [22] and [2,22] for every geometrically split abelian surface over ℚ, independently of the geometric splitting degree

Geometric2639Obstruction.cite: No rational points of order 26 or 39 on geometrically split abelian surfaces, census proof of 21 October 2026. Coprime torsion in elliptic isogeny classes over fields of degree at most 4, a local point count at 2 and 3 for CM squares, residual representations at 13 for non-CM squares, and, for a cyclic sextic endomorphism field, the rational points of X_0(39)/w_3 and the 3-torsion; Magma checks in geometric_26_39_x039_w3.log.
Geometric2639Obstruction.used_for: impossibility of [26], [2,26] and [39] for every geometrically split abelian surface over ℚ, independently of the geometric splitting degree

QSimple13Obstruction.cite: No rational 13-torsion on a geometrically split genus-2 Jacobian simple over Q, census proof of 21 October 2026. Case analysis of the Galois action on the geometric endomorphism algebra; in the only two cases that allow a rational point of order 13, the isogeny class carries no principal polarization, or only product polarizations. Standalone Magma scripts and logs.
QSimple13Obstruction.used_for: impossibility of [13] in the geometrically split, simple-over-ℚ class; uses the principal polarization of the Jacobian

QSimple30Obstruction.cite: No rational 30-torsion on a geometrically split abelian surface simple over Q, census proof of 21 October 2026. Coprime torsion in elliptic isogeny classes, a local obstruction at 2 for CM squares (no Q_2-point of order 15, via good reduction over a totally ramified extension and Tate's theorem), and a residual Galois argument at 5 for non-CM squares.
QSimple30Obstruction.used_for: impossibility of [30], [60] and [2,30] only in the geometrically split, simple-over-ℚ class

QSimple63Obstruction.cite: No rational 63-torsion on a geometrically split abelian surface simple over Q, census proof of 21 October 2026. Coprime torsion in elliptic isogeny classes, residual representations at 7, the 3-torsion of non-CM squares with cyclic sextic endomorphism field, and the cubic 21-torsion of 162b1 with a point count at 5; Magma checks in qsimple_63_arithmetic.log.
QSimple63Obstruction.used_for: impossibility of [63] only in the geometrically split, simple-over-ℚ class

QSimpleRankTwoObstruction.cite: Rational p-torsion of rank two on geometrically split abelian surfaces simple over Q, census proof of 21 October 2026. Polarization duality restricts the residual composition factors to 1, χ and χ⁻¹ for p ≥ 5; the Galois action on the geometric endomorphism algebra and complex conjugation then give a contradiction.
QSimpleRankTwoObstruction.used_for: impossibility of [5,5], [5,10] and [7,7] only in the geometrically split, simple-over-ℚ class
